Cada fila marcada invalida su hecho al a: Each ticked row invalidates its fact on approval; the unticked ones are rejected with the note.
Correcciones pendientes con el mismo aut: Pending corrections with the same author and origin: reviewed together, in one table, instead of one by one. Approving applies the ticked ones, each as its own correction, undone on its own; the unticked ones are rejected with the group's note. They also stay in the queue, should you prefer to decide one alone.
